title: Concept: AWS credentials file served
description: An AWS shared-credentials file is served at this endpoint, so an access key id and its secret are readable together and can be used directly against the account.
applicability: Responses that serve files from a document root or a home directory.
risk: Anyone who reads the file uses the key pair directly against the account, with whatever permissions the key holds; HIGH because the pair is directly usable without cracking.
